_comment: Recipe sources the wiki states and the game files do not.
Every recipe_scroll and crafting_scroll in the game files is collected, so
a recipe listed here has genuinely NO stated grant anywhere in the files —
it would otherwise ship the skill_level-inferred fallback. The wiki states
the real mechanism for these, and per the precedence rule the more
specific source wins: a wiki-stated source replaces the inferred row.
Shape: recipe id -> a list of { method, source_id }. The loader fills the
rest (confidence 'wiki', no price) — only these two fields may be stated,
so this file cannot quietly become a hand-edit of the generated tier. An
id that matches no built recipe fails the build; a `perk` source_id is
validated against the game's perk table.
The three statues' scrolls: the sealed caves the boxes sit in are the ones
opened with Dragon's Breath — our spots data carries sealed_beach_cave and
sealed_narrows_cave — but the ability has no model, so the source states
the box and the place, not the door.

water_sprite.reason: no scroll grant exists in the game files; the wiki states the recipe is in a Golden Treasure Box within The Beach Cave

ocarina_sprite_statue.reason: no scroll grant exists in the game files; the wiki states the recipe is in a Golden Treasure Box within The Narrows Cave

water_sprite_large.reason: the wiki states the recipe comes from the Big Water Sprites woodcrafting perk; the game states the link only in the perk's prose, which is never read
